comments.author: backlog
comments.text: REVIEW FIX (P1): validateAndPlanOperations now checks virtualState before fs.access for add and move existence checks. This allows same-patch sequences like delete→add, move→add-back, and delete-destination→move. Tests added in apply-patch.test.ts.}

comments.author: backlog
comments.text: REVIEW FIX (P0): validateAndPlanOperations now precomputes laterWritePaths per operation index. Move destination existence check tolerates existing files on disk when a later operation in the same patch will overwrite that destination. Regression test: move A->B then update B.
